air_quality.label: Air Quality
air_quality.desc: Air quality events include haze, wildfire smoke, industrial emissions, particulate pollution, smog, dust storms, and other airborne contaminants that may affect personnel health and welfare, outdoor security duties, patrols, visibility, staff travel, transportation, cooling systems, or datacenter operations.
monitor: Monitor air quality when conditions begin to deteriorate but remain below the **UNHEALTHY** threshold, and forecasts indicate further deterioration within the next **24 to 72 hours**

Authorities issue stay-indoors orders, work-restriction, or public-health emergency advisories
cad: Update every **6 hours**
Provide an immediate update if AQI, API, or PSI reaches the **VERY UNHEALTHY** category
Provide an immediate update if public health advisories are issued, expanded, escalated, or lifted
end: Provide a final update when AQI, API, or PSI returns to the **MODERATE** category and remains at that level for **72 hours**

trig: AQI, API, or PSI reaches **201 or higher (VERY UNHEALTHY)**
Authorities issue stay-indoors orders, work-restriction, or public-health emergency advisories
cad: Update every **24 hours**
Provide an immediate update if AQI, API, or PSI reaches the **HAZARDOUS** category (**>300 AQI**)
Provide an immediate update if public health advisories are issued, expanded, escalated, or lifted
end: Provide a final update when AQI, API, or PSI returns to the **MODERATE** category and remains at that level for **72 hours**

crit: AQI, API, or PSI reaches, or is forecast to reach, **150** or higher (**UNHEALTHY**)
Authorities issue stay-indoors orders, work-restriction, or public-health emergency advisories
cad: Provide an immediate update if AQI, API, or PSI escalates by one or more categories
Provide an immediate update if AQI, API, or PSI reaches the **HAZARDOUS** category
Provide an immediate update if public health advisories are issued, expanded, escalated, or lifted
ren.reason: The AQI/API/PSI threshold of 150 marks the transition into the Unhealthy category, where conditions may begin affecting the general population, personnel welfare, outdoor security duties, commuting, visibility, and site operations. Reporting at this level gives stakeholders lead time for risk assessment, operational planning, and protective measures before conditions reach Very Unhealthy (201+).

close: Air quality remains within the **MODERATE** category or lower for **72 hours**
Local authority restrictions or public-health advisories are lifted
No further significant deterioration is forecast
No further impact on Security Operations is anticipated
cons: Review of outdoor patrol requirements
Adjust the frequency or duration of external duties
Monitor personnel welfare
Assess visibility impacts on vehicle movements and datacenter access

Maintain awareness of local authority guidance
psoc: Monitor official air-quality indices and authority advisories

Escalate material changes in accordance with the defined reporting thresholds
air_quality.note: Air quality may be reported as AQI, API, or PSI depending on the local authority. These indices are not always directly interchangeable; refer to the official local reporting scale before applying SOP thresholds.
